# sigma_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a Sigma template by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_template" "example" {
  id = "template-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Template ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the template is archived.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest template version.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `path` (String) Template path.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Version tags on the template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Template URL.
- `url_id` (String) Template URL ID.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `version_tag_id` (String) Version tag ID.
